sample_unit: LLM outputs (10 cases x 3 conditions x 4 models)

links.outcome: Bias in LLM diagnostic and treatment outputs when patient race was neutral, implied, or explicit
links.effect: LLMs often proposed inferior treatments when race was explicitly or implicitly indicated; diagnostic decisions showed minimal bias. NewMes-15 showed most bias, Gemini least.
links.quote: Results indicated that LLMs often proposed inferior treatments when patient race was explicitly or implicitly indicated, though diagnostic decisions demonstrated minimal bias.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating four large language models on simulated psychiatric patient cases across different racial cue conditions to evaluate algorithmic bias.
